items.title: Sprouts Farmers Market (SFM) Stock May Be 45% Below Fair Value After Apollo Backstory
items.summary: Sprouts Farmers Market has delivered a 94.4% share price gain over the past 5 years, yet the recent slide this year raises a sharper question about how well that trajectory lines up with the cash the business can generate. With the stock last closing at US$51.37, the key issue now is whether today’s market value is fully supported by the stream of cash flows investors expect Sprouts to produce. items.title: PE's £150B decade-long UK stock market binge in one chart
items.summary: Private equity has agreed £25.1 billion (around $33 billion) of London take-privates this year—up from £14.3 billion last year—as ever larger funds turn to discounted UK plc to deploy their capital. In all, 11 deals have been agreed this year; five of them, worth £2.3 billion, have completed. The other £22.8 billion comprises six pending deals; among them are EQT’s Intertek deal at £10.9 billion and Apollo Global Management’s planned easyJet purchase at £5.7 billion.
